sde.heroTagline: I build secure, scalable backend systems — engineered with a tester's eye for reliability.
about: **🚀 Java Backend Developer** with 2+ years of experience building secure, scalable microservices and enterprise-grade APIs using **Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful services**. Adept at designing clean, resilient systems and integrating with both **SQL and NoSQL** databases. Hands-on with **AWS** and crafting robust **CI/CD pipelines** for fast, safe deployments.

**🛠️ Base foundation** – Started my journey as a Software Engineer where I built automation frameworks, wrote reusable Java utilities, and contributed to system reliability. That hands-on exposure sparked a passion for backend development and led me to learn **Spring Boot, database optimization, and DSA**.

**💡 Problem-Solver at heart** – I love building things that work — efficiently and at scale. From writing unit-tested Java services to optimizing queries and designing fault-tolerant APIs, I aim to blend development velocity with long-term stability.

**📈 Transitioning into full-time backend engineering** – Seeking opportunities where I can architect performant systems, write production-grade code, and contribute to meaningful tech challenges. Passionate about clean code, cloud-native services, and continuous improvement.
**🎯 Unique Edge** – My SDET background means I naturally prioritize **testability, observability, and performance** from day one — building systems that are not just functional, but dependable.
**🌱 Mission** – To grow as a backend engineer, contribute to real-world products, and work in environments that value learning, mentorship, and engineering excellence.

bullets: Reduced test execution time by 55% through optimized integration, regression, and load testing for real-time APIs built on FastAPI, Spring Boot, J2EE, using JMeter and DataDog for performance measurement.
Saved 48% infrastructure costs by migrating from static Jenkins agents to ephemeral Docker-based Jenkins agents on AWS EC2, improving scalability and resource utilization.

Eliminated third-party licensing costs by building in-house self-healing and visual testing features like image comparison within the Selenium automation framework, replacing tools like Applitools or Browser.
Designed and maintained CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, integrated with Docker, improving test efficiency by 85% and achieving 90%+ sanity and regression suite coverage.
Automated JIRA workflows such as bug creation, high-priority issue tracking, and test result summarization, improving team productivity and reducing manual effort by 60%.

Developed secure data modules using RSA, AES, and Digital Signature algorithms, reverse-engineered Java and Ruby decryption logic, and built Python-based encryption/compression pipelines for secure data transmission.
Built and deployed a real-time production health dashboard using FastAPI, MySQL, JavaScript, and AWS CloudWatch, reducing incident response time by 40%.
Collaborated with backend teams using Spring Boot, Hibernate, Kafka, and Microservices to validate APIs, implement integration tests, and automate data validations across SQL and NoSQL databases.
Executed comprehensive end-to-end test suites for web, API, and mobile platforms, focusing on applications developed with Java, FastAPI, and Spring, continuously improving coverage to over 85%.

Able to script test cases with coverage and maintenance with improved execution speed of scripts. Enhanced load testing capabilities (through JMeter and DataDog): set up and scripted load tests for real-time APIs and measured performance.
Achieved 90%+ sanity and regression suite coverage, improved 2 suites to 85%+ range, executed suites and analyzed them on releases.
Automated other necessary tasks like Jira tasks and other small execution tasks. Gained knowledge in mobile testing to increase testing knowledge for multiple devices.
Able to do end-to-end testing for many modules in web automation, API, and mobile.
Developed an approach to automatically generate valid test cases for given system code.
Used GTest Testing Framework, Decision-to-decision path graph, and Data Flow testing technique.
Developed secure authentication systems using Passport.js and Express.js, handling authentication for over 10,000 users across multiple applications.
Implemented and optimized session management and user authorization flows, reducing authentication-related bugs by 30%.
Integrated third-party OAuth providers (Google, Facebook, etc.) for seamless user onboarding, increasing sign-up efficiency by 40%.
Enhanced security protocols, contributing to a reduction in unauthorized access incidents.
Developed Python-based solutions for various projects, enhancing functionality and performance.

projects.title: CryptSend: Secure Web-Based File Sharing
projects.tagline: A secure web-based file-sharing platform using advanced cryptographic algorithms to ensure confidentiality and integrity of shared files.
points: 💡 Problem: Traditional file-sharing services lack end-to-end encryption, exposing sensitive data to security risks.
✅ Ensured secure file sharing with zero third-party access.
✅ End-to-end encryption prevents man-in-the-middle attacks.
✅ User-friendly platform with seamless encryption & decryption.

sdet.heroTagline: I break software before your users do — automation, CI/CD, and quality engineering at scale.
about: **🚀 SDET** – Automation Engineer at Enphase, specializing in test automation, CI/CD, and performance optimization. I have developed, maintained, and executed automated test scripts for Web & Mobile applications using Selenium, Appium, and Playwright, achieving 90%+ test coverage across multiple projects. My expertise extends to integration, regression, and performance testing, ensuring software stability and reliability.

**⚡ DevOps & Test Automation Innovator** – Implemented CI/CD pipelines, reducing deployment risks and ensuring zero critical defects post-release. Leveraged Docker for containerization, optimizing test environments for consistency and scalability.

**💡 Passionate** about large-scale distributed systems, automation frameworks, and performance optimization. A strong advocate of shift-left testing, ensuring early defect detection and seamless integration of automation into development lifecycles.
**🎓 Computer Science & Engineering** graduate from Vellore Institute of Technology with a strong foundation in software development, automation strategies, and problem-solving.

**🏋️‍♂️ Beyond tech** – I'm an athlete, passionate about trekking, swimming, squash, bodybuilding, public speaking, and constantly learning new technologies. Actively involved in tech meet-ups, knowledge sharing, and upskilling.
**🔹 Mission** – To drive innovation in test automation, DevOps, and software quality, ensuring scalable, high-performing solutions for modern tech ecosystems.

bullets: Developed, maintained, and executed automated test scripts for Web applications and Mobile apps using Selenium, Appium, and other appropriate tools, achieving over 90% test coverage in 3 different projects ENLM, ENLA and over 70% in ENHO projects.

Performed integration testing, regression testing, and performance testing to ensure the stability and reliability of our software products, including load tests for real-time APIs using JMeter and DataDog, reducing sanity test execution time from 45 minutes to 20 minutes.

Implemented and maintained CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, resulting in zero critical defects post version 23.1 due to continuous execution and monitoring. Achieved over 90% coverage in sanity and regression suites, improving two suites to over 85%.

Monitored and analyzed test results, tracked defects, and reported testing progress, prioritizing and following up on 40 out of 58 high-priority JIRA tickets with the CS team and raising 43 JIRA defects for ENLM and 4 for GS projects within 6 months.

Automated several routine tasks, including bug creation, pushing summary data to the database, and fetching high-priority tickets and issues to reduce manual workload, minimize errors, and allow the team to focus on more strategic activities.

Utilized state-of-the-art cryptographic methods such as Digital Signature Creation, RSA, and AES for encryption, and the Deflate algorithm for compression by reverse-engineering existing decryption and decompression methods from Java/Ruby to create robust compression and encryption algorithms in Python.
Wrote and optimized SQL queries to ensure rapid and efficient data retrieval.

Designed and implemented a dashboard to provide real-time status updates on health reports for multiple projects in the production environment. This tool significantly improved monitoring capabilities and facilitated quicker decision-making for the team.
